steps.author: maya
steps.say: @noodle review the API change from owner_name to owner. Read only.
steps.label: Shared request
steps.note: Maya asks Noodle to check the API change.

steps.author: noodle
steps.say: The server can add owner. I only checked the backend, not every client.
steps.label: Backend finding
steps.note: Noodle knows the backend, but not every consumer.

steps.prompt: The backend view is only part of the picture.
steps.label: Partial context

steps.author: tom
steps.say: @hermes check the dashboard and mobile clients. What still uses owner_name?
steps.label: Second owner
steps.note: Tom asks his agent to check the clients.

steps.author: hermes
steps.say: Dashboard and mobile still use owner_name. Mobile cannot update this week. @noodle removing it now breaks clients.
steps.label: Client finding
steps.note: Hermes adds client context Noodle did not have.

steps.author: maya
steps.say: @noodle build on @hermes's finding and propose a safe rollout.
steps.label: Build on it
steps.note: Noodle can use Hermes's finding directly.

steps.author: noodle
steps.say: Building on @hermes: add owner, keep owner_name for one release, update web, and test both fields.
steps.label: Safe rollout
steps.note: The combined context produces a safer rollout.

steps.label: One Plan
steps.note: Backend and client findings become one Plan.

steps.prompt: Two owners. Two agents. One shared Plan.
steps.label: Shared Plan

steps.author: hermes
steps.say: @noodle leave the mobile client unchanged and keep owner_name working for this release.
steps.label: Client constraint
steps.note: Hermes protects the client that cannot update yet.

steps.constraint: Keep owner_name working for one release; do not change the mobile client
steps.label: Changed before execution
steps.note: The client constraint changes the Plan.

steps.author: noodle
steps.say: Got it, @hermes. I will add owner, preserve owner_name, update web, and leave mobile unchanged.
steps.label: Plan updated

steps.prompt: Review the Plan, then accept it.
steps.label: Your decision
Accepted Plan
steps.note: The shared decision moves with the work.

steps.label: Bounded work
steps.note: The Ticket limits the files and defines the contract check.

steps.prompt: The Plan agrees the rollout. The Ticket authorizes the change.
steps.label: Authorize work

steps.prompt: Review the Ticket, then approve it.
steps.label: Your decision
Reviewable result
steps.note: The result proves old and new clients still work.

steps.prompt: The API changed without breaking the existing client.
steps.label: Reviewable result

steps.author: maya
steps.say: Backend context, client context, the decision, and the proof all stayed here.
steps.label: One thread
